fields.name: Name
fields.commandTopicPlaceholder: leave empty to use the profile’s topic

lockProfileHint.native_json: Publishes this system’s JSON to the address, and the firmware releases itself after the hold.
lockProfileHint.tasmota: Publishes ON to cmnd/<address>/POWER, then OFF after the hold. Set PulseTime on the plug too, so a backend restart cannot leave it closed.
lockProfileHint.shelly: Publishes on to <address>/relay/0/command, then off after the hold.
lockProfileHint.esphome_switch: Publishes ON to <address>/command, then OFF. Address is the entity path, e.g. node/switch/strike.
lockProfileHint.zigbee2mqtt: Publishes {"state":"ON"} to <address>/set, then OFF after the hold.
lockProfileHint.custom: Sends exactly what you type below. Leave the release payload empty and nothing is sent to close it.
